 Internship: Circular wastewater treatment 
 bij Nijhuis Saur Industries in Doetinchem 
 Doetinchem Stage 
 Geplaatst op mei 20, 2026 
It is time to rethink our urban wastewater treatment plants. The current generation of wastewater treatment systems focus on the destruction of carbon compounds and of nutrients, instead of on energy and nutrient recovery. Can we turn this around and go to energy positive wastewater treatment plants that harvest valuable materials? This is an ambitious topic which involves combining many innovative, as well as existing technologies, of both biological and physical-chemical nature. In this manner, a positive impact can be made on the footprint of wastewater treatment, to achieve a circular wastewater treatment plant. 
Your goal 
In this internship you will explore innovative treatments and reuse strategies for wastewaters and nutrients, to bring a more circular approach closer to reality. 
What will you be doing? We have listed it for you: - 
Conduct laboratory experiments to find optimal operational parameters for resource recovery technologies. - 
Evaluate approaches taken in literature. - 
Develop a process scheme for a circular wastewater treatment plant for which you investigate the feasibility. 
You will work on applied research in circular wastewater treatment, helping to bring innovative solutions to the market. 
Who are you? -

De Hoge Veluwe National Park is unique, thanks to its unusual combination of nature and art. 
In a single location, you can see wild animals, marvel at the extraordinary historic Veluwe landscapes and visit the museum with the world's second-largest Van Gogh collection: the Kröller-Müller Museum . 
You can also take part in a variety of different organized activities. For example, your guests can go on safari with the forest ranger or enjoy a guided nature trail. Of course, people are also free to discover the stunning natural beauty at their own initiative, since there are so many beautiful things to see while walking or cycling. As many as 1,800 free White Bicycles are ready and waiting. In addition, a variety of bikes are available to rent. It is also possible to take a guided tour of the world-famous Country Residence/Museum Jachthuis Sint Hubertus, designed by H.P. Berlage. 
 Book tickets
